title: /cost Per-Model and Cache Breakdown (v2.1.92)
description: The /cost command now shows per-model cost breakdown and cache-hit breakdown for subscription (Max plan) users. Previously showed only aggregate totals. Useful for understanding token spend distribution across model tiers in multi-agent sessions (Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku), and for verifying prompt cache effectiveness.

evaluation.reasoning: Directly applicable to Max plan multi-agent sessions — enables per-model spend visibility across Opus/Sonnet/Haiku subagent calls and cache effectiveness verification. Built-in, zero config, zero maintenance. Addresses a real debugging need in the evolution/heartbeat pipeline.
